_about: Test notes for the Sawbones' effects workbook (tools/gh_testsheet.py). turns: the test hand in play order; an entry with "rest" is a long rest for the whole party. picks: the level-up card picks the hand needs. states: what Gloomhaven shows per animator state, where known; the rest is generated from the pack data.
setup: His medical packs go to adjacent allies: have the Scoundrel or the Quartermaster next to him on turns 1 and 5, and have them PLAY the Medical Pack card they receive (it appears in their hand) to check it heals and goes away.

turns.order: Bottom first: move 4 next to an ally, then give them a Medical Pack.
turns.setup: An ally to end adjacent to.

turns.order: Bottom first: move 3 next to an ally and clear their conditions (the adjacent buff), then the plain saw attack on an enemy.
turns.setup: An ally (with a condition, ideally) and an enemy adjacent.

turns.order: Top: the ranged area attack (Attack 1, range 3). Bottom: Shield 1 on an adjacent ally.
Top: disarm the adjacent enemies (the radial debuff). Bottom: his persistent bonus (the power-up).
Bottom first: move 5 next to enemies and wound them (the radial debuff), then give an adjacent ally a Large Medical Pack.
turns.setup: Enemies and an ally adjacent after the move.

turns.order: Top: the heavy saw swing (Attack 7). Bottom: Loot 1.
turns.setup: An enemy adjacent; a coin adjacent.

turns.order: Top: Heal 3 on an adjacent ally. Bottom: Shield 1 on the adjacent allies (the radial buff).
Top: the plain attack (Attack 4). Bottom: Move 4.

states.GivePackAdjacent: He hands a pack to the adjacent ally, with the give-medipack sound; the ally gets the Medical Pack card in hand.
states.Attack: A saw swing with his melee attack sound and the weapon impact.
states.Attack_AOE_Cone: The heavy two-handed saw swing with the heavy-attack sound.
states.BuffAdjacent: A quick treatment on the adjacent ally with the buff-adjacent sound.
states.RadialBuff: A ring over the adjacent allies with the radial-buff sound.
states.RadialDebuff: A cloud over the adjacent enemies with the radial-debuff sound.
states.RangedAreaAttack: A thrown vial at the target area with the ranged-attack cast sound.
states.Heal: The cast pose with his heal sound.
states.PowerUp: The cast pose with his power-up sound.
states.Loot: His loot stoop with the loot sound.
